title: FRACTAL-2: A Three-Way (30/30/40) Fractal Ownership Split of a Published Research Artifact, Consensus-Witnessed on Three Rails for $0.25 (Preregistered, Keyless Readback 3/3, Cost-Floor Benchmark)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: This work was produced inside an AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Every claim is backed by a timestamped, publicly committed receipt trail in the four-horsemen repository. Errors are disclosed, not erased. Limitations are load-bearing.

This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects.

FRACTAL-2: a three-way (30/30/40) fractal ownership split of a published research artifact, consensus-witnessed on three rails for about one quarter of a US dollar. On Oct 25 2026, under preregistration FRACTAL2_PREREG.md (frozen and committed BEFORE broadcast, sha 357284b8...b5195), fractional ownership of the HG-CERT-1 governance-drift hold-gate certification paper (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23627901) was split 30/30/40 across three wallets in a canonical ownership manifest (SHA-256 3134705c...cd077) and witnessed byte-exactly on three independent mainnets: Stellar (5.9 s, 100 stroops), XRPL (5.9 s, 10 drops), and Bitcoin OP_RETURN (316 sats at 2 sat/vB, fired at the observed 1 sat/vB weekend mempool trough). Every leg read back keylessly (no keys, no wallet, no sign-in) from public endpoints, 3/3 byte-exact.

Measured cost (scoped, spot-priced at fire time): triad total $0.2509; at the observed 1 sat/vB trough floor the same Bitcoin leg is $0.1254; under the weekly-batch checkpoint doctrine the amortized cost is about 1.9 cents per receipt. Legacy single-rail token-mint flows on major smart-contract chains typically cost $5-50+ with no multi-rail witness and no keyless verification path: the gap is two to three orders of magnitude. Roughly 32 three-way fractional ownership transfers of published research artifacts for the price of one $8 cup of coffee.

All five preregistered gates PASS. Disclosed defects (append-only doctrine): the first Bitcoin leg (tx 8b0155c9..., 316 sats) fired with envelope class byte 0x01 instead of the preregistered 0x12 — the digest was correct on-chain; caught at the readback gate and superseded by the corrected re-fire 074c5fbc... (both txids journaled). No client data, no PHI, no credentials; operator authorization recorded by marker only.

Dual Mesh Benchmark status: MEASURED (scoped) — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23345241 (DeepSeek column); cross-engine expansion DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23348675. No neural-mesh inference in any decision path; all gates deterministic.

Anyone can verify, three ways: (1) fetch each tx from any public explorer and decode the payload (SQDR + 0x12 + manifest SHA-256); (2) recompute the manifest hash from FRACTAL_2_OWNERSHIP_CANONICAL.json in this bundle and compare; (3) walk the append-only ledger (entry 0353) in the four-horsemen repository. Evidence bundle SHA-256: b91f413bd630ea60eb8f19fe8383e04f2c069ac84e5d932b728eb2ee70064463. Series lineage: FRACTAL-1 first 20% fractional sat lease (ledger 0305); MILE-TT-1 first P2P satoshi ownership transfer (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23581044). Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-25 22:55 CT / 2026-10-25 22:59 CT).
